name: Porta-Jazz ao Relento
description: Four evenings of free, open-air jazz concerts set against the stunning backdrop of the Crystal Palace Gardens at sunset.
longDescription:
Porta-Jazz ao Relento presents four evenings of jazz performances, organised by the Porta-Jazz association. This annual event aims to bring contemporary jazz to a wider audience in Porto, offering a platform for both established and emerging musicians within the genre. The programming typically features a diverse range of jazz styles, from traditional to more experimental approaches, showcasing the breadth of the Portuguese jazz scene.

Attendees can expect a relaxed, open-air atmosphere as the concerts unfold during the late afternoon and early evening hours. The setting within the Jardins do Palácio de Cristal provides a spacious, natural environment for enjoying the music. The event attracts a mixed audience, including jazz enthusiasts, local residents, and visitors to the city, all gathered to enjoy live music in a scenic location. The performances are primarily instrumental, making them accessible to a non-Portuguese speaking audience.

Admission to all concerts is free, with no prior booking required. Visitors are welcome to find a spot on the grass or bring their own blankets. The Jardins do Palácio de Cristal are centrally located and can be reached by walking from the city centre, or via various bus routes serving the area. The gardens offer paved pathways and accessible entry points.
